stem: Which of the following lines does the playwright include to show that the boy is clever?

options.label: A
options.text: BOY: My mother has gone to the market to sell fans so that she can buy oil for our lamps. Isn’t that what you would call selling the wind to buy the moon?

options.label: C
options.text: BOY: I do have a witness, Your Honor.

options.label: D
options.text: BOY: [Appearing in the doorway.] No! You don’t owe him. He promised me he would forget about the debt.
